title: Report unreadable artifacts without aborting archive candidates
description:
## Objective

Make archive planning and candidate reporting resilient to directory-valued or otherwise unsupported issue document paths while preserving deterministic, path-specific diagnostics.

## Success Criteria

- [hard] `jit archive candidates --json` evaluates and returns every candidate deterministically when repository-wide explicit or embedded roots include a directory; no candidate is omitted because another issue has such a document path.
- [hard] Direct container/document preview returns a plan with a stable path-specific blocker or warning for an unsupported artifact instead of aborting, and execution remains blocked.
- [hard] Supported artifacts and ownership classification are unchanged; infrastructure failures that cannot be represented safely are not silently swallowed.
- [hard] Tests cover a directory-valued local dependency, repository-wide candidate evaluation, no mutation, and canonical JSON diagnostics.
- [hard] User-facing reference documentation defines the diagnostic and report behavior.
